en: Black‑and‑white view of a cobbled courtyard enclosed by Renaissance and Baroque buildings. On the left stands a massive, older-looking structure with a steep gabled roof and small dormer windows, attached to a round tower and ivy‑covered walls. In the center rises a more ornate palace façade with triangular gables and a tall tower with a lantern and spire. On the right is a long arcade-like wing with repeated arched windows and sculpted figures above them, also covered in ivy. Several slender lampposts and simple metal posts line the otherwise empty courtyard. At the very bottom of the image, faint handwritten text appears to read something like a date, possibly "1902," mirrored or upside down.
